status: candidate, never applied to a camera. The old bytes are verified against the extracted firmware; nothing else is.
purpose: Make the sensor's 16:9 readout window (7008x3942) read the whole 3:2 sensor area (7008x4672), by giving its vertical group the values the firmware's own full-height records already use.

target.table: readout-mode table at 0xdd81d8, 53 records of 38 bytes; see scripts/locate_sensor_table.py

reference: This mirrors the A7 IV kit's step 2 (ogsq_v3 / og57n_v1), which changes the same three fields of the same record shape at its own addresses. Those addresses do not apply here.

patches.note: record 0xdd832e, vertical field 2: 2 -> 8, the value the 4672 records carry
record 0xdd832e, vertical field 6: 2 -> 8, the value the 4672 records carry
